title: CDC Open Data (data.cdc.gov)
agency: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
questions: leading causes of death by state
county health indicators such as obesity or diabetes

manual.how: Open the dataset page (https://data.cdc.gov/d/<id>), choose Export > CSV, and upload the file; or open the CSV links in INSTRUCTIONS.md.

cache.why: Queries are small and provisional datasets change weekly; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: CDC data are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); CDC asks for attribution and no implied endorsement.

citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, {dataset}, data.cdc.gov (Socrata API), retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Final or provisional counts? Provisional series (weekly deaths, VSRR overdose) are revised for months; say which and the data date.
Counts or age-adjusted rates? Compare places with age-adjusted rates.
